## Database Schema
Table: kr_individual_investor_daily_trading
Description: Per-stock investor type trading data (foreign, institution, retail)
Primary Key: (symbol, date)
Columns:
- date (DATE): Trading date
- symbol (VARCHAR): Stock code
- inst_buy_volume (BIGINT): Institution buy volume
- inst_sell_volume (BIGINT): Institution sell volume
- inst_net_volume (BIGINT): Institution net volume
- inst_buy_value (BIGINT): Institution buy value (KRW)
- inst_sell_value (BIGINT): Institution sell value (KRW)
- inst_net_value (BIGINT): Institution net value (KRW)
- inst_buy_ratio (DECIMAL): Institution buy ratio (%)
- retail_buy_volume (BIGINT): Retail/individual buy volume
- retail_sell_volume (BIGINT): Retail sell volume
- retail_net_volume (BIGINT): Retail net volume
- retail_buy_value (BIGINT): Retail buy value (KRW)
- retail_sell_value (BIGINT): Retail sell value (KRW)
- retail_net_value (BIGINT): Retail net value (KRW)
- retail_buy_ratio (DECIMAL): Retail buy ratio (%)
- foreign_buy_volume (BIGINT): Foreign buy volume
- foreign_sell_volume (BIGINT): Foreign sell volume
- foreign_net_volume (BIGINT): Foreign net volume (buy - sell)
- foreign_buy_value (BIGINT): Foreign buy value (KRW)
- foreign_sell_value (BIGINT): Foreign sell value (KRW)
- foreign_net_value (BIGINT): Foreign net value (KRW)
- foreign_buy_ratio (DECIMAL): Foreign buy ratio (%)
- total_buy_volume (BIGINT): Total buy volume
- total_sell_volume (BIGINT): Total sell volume
- total_net_volume (BIGINT): Total net volume
- total_buy_value (BIGINT): Total trading value
- total_sell_value (BIGINT): Total sell value
- total_net_value (BIGINT): Total net value
Usage: JOIN with kr_intraday ON symbol for investor flow analysis

Table: kr_intraday_total
Description: Korean stock historical daily quote data (has date column)
Primary Key: (symbol, date)
Columns:
- symbol (VARCHAR): Stock code
- stock_name (VARCHAR): Stock name in Korean
- exchange (VARCHAR): Exchange (KOSPI, KOSDAQ)
- close (NUMERIC): Closing price (KRW)
- change_amount (NUMERIC): Price change amount (KRW)
- change_rate (NUMERIC): Price change rate (%)
- open (NUMERIC): Opening price
- high (NUMERIC): Day high price
- low (NUMERIC): Day low price
- volume (BIGINT): Trading volume
- trading_value (BIGINT): Trading value (KRW)
- market_cap (NUMERIC): Market capitalization
- listed_shares (BIGINT): Listed shares
- eps (NUMERIC): Earnings per share
- per (NUMERIC): Price to Earnings Ratio
- roe (NUMERIC): Return on Equity
- bps (NUMERIC): Book value per share
- pbr (NUMERIC): Price to Book Ratio
- dps (NUMERIC): Dividend per share
- dividend_yield (NUMERIC): Dividend yield (%)
- date (DATE): Trading date
- avg_trading_value_5d (BIGINT): 5-day average trading value
- avg_trading_value_20d (BIGINT): 20-day average trading value
- avg_trading_value_60d (BIGINT): 60-day average trading value
- avg_trading_value_200d (BIGINT): 200-day average trading value
- avg_volume_5d (BIGINT): 5-day average volume
- avg_volume_20d (BIGINT): 20-day average volume
- avg_volume_60d (BIGINT): 60-day average volume
- avg_volume_200d (BIGINT): 200-day average volume
Usage: Historical data queries. JOIN with kr_indicators ON symbol AND date.

## Term Mapping
## Price/Quote Terms
- 현재가, 종가 -> close
- 시가 -> open
- 고가 -> high
- 저가 -> low
- 거래량 -> volume
- 거래대금 -> trading_value
- 시총, 시가총액 -> market_cap
- 등락률, 변동률 -> change_rate

## Technical Indicators (in kr_indicators or us_indicators)
- RSI, 알에스아이 -> rsi
- MACD -> macd, macd_signal, macd_hist
- 볼린저밴드 -> real_upper_band, real_middle_band, real_lower_band
- 이평선, 이동평균, SMA -> sma
- EMA, 지수이동평균 -> ema
- VWAP -> vwap, eod_vwap, avg_vwap
- ATR -> atr
- 스토캐스틱 -> slowk, slowd
- MFI -> mfi
- ADX -> adx
- ROC -> roc
- OBV -> obv
- CCI -> cci

## Conditions
- 과매수 -> rsi > 70
- 과매도 -> rsi < 30
- 골든크로스 -> macd > macd_signal
- 데드크로스 -> macd < macd_signal
- 대형주 -> market_cap >= 10000000000000 (10 trillion KRW)
- 중형주 -> market_cap >= 1000000000000 AND market_cap < 10000000000000
- 상한가 -> change_rate >= 29.9
- 하한가 -> change_rate <= -29.9

## Investor Types (Korean market only, from kr_individual_investor_daily_trading)
- 외국인, 외인 -> foreign_net_volume, foreign_net_value
- 기관 -> inst_net_volume, inst_net_value
- 개인, 개미 -> retail_net_volume, retail_net_value
- 순매수 -> net_volume > 0
- 순매도 -> net_volume < 0

## Quant Grades (from kr_stock_grade / us_stock_grade)
- 종합등급, 투자등급 -> final_grade
- 종합점수, 최종점수 -> final_score
- 가치점수 -> value_score
- 퀄리티점수, 품질점수 -> quality_score
- 모멘텀점수 -> momentum_score
- 성장점수 -> growth_score
- 신뢰도점수 -> confidence_score
- 매수 등급 -> final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
- 강력 매수 -> final_grade = '강력 매수'
- 매수 고려 이상 -> final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수', '매수 고려')
- 매도 등급 -> final_grade IN ('매도', '강력 매도')

## Market Index
- 코스피 -> exchange = 'KOSPI'
- 코스닥 -> exchange = 'KOSDAQ'
- 나스닥 -> exchange = 'NASDAQ'
- 뉴욕증시 -> exchange = 'NYSE'

## Question
각 거래소별로 일일 수익률 상위 10위 종목을 랭킹하고, 전일 대비 기관 순매수 금액과 외국인 순매수 금액을 함께 표시하시오

WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(date) as max_date FROM kr_intraday_total), daily_returns AS (SELECT kit.symbol, kit.stock_name, kit.exchange, kit.change_rate, kit.close, kit.date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kit.exchange ORDER BY kit.change_rate DESC) as return_rank FROM kr_intraday_total kit INNER JOIN latest_date ld ON kit.date = ld.max_date WHERE kit.change_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT dr.return_rank, dr.exchange, dr.symbol, dr.stock_name, dr.change_rate, dr.close, COALESCE(kit.inst_net_value, 0) as inst_net_value, COALESCE(kit.foreign_net_value, 0) as foreign_net_value FROM daily_returns dr LEFT JOIN kr_individual_investor_daily_trading kit ON dr.symbol = kit.symbol AND dr.date = kit.date WHERE dr.return_rank <= 10 ORDER BY dr.exchange, dr.return_rank

## Question
전주 대비 거래량이 크게 증가한 주식들을 찾아주세요

WITH this_week AS (
    SELECT symbol, AVG(volume) as this_week_vol
    FROM kr_intraday_total
    WHERE date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_intraday_total))
    GROUP BY symbol
),
last_week AS (
    SELECT symbol, AVG(volume) as last_week_vol
    FROM kr_intraday_total
    WHERE date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_intraday_total)) - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND date < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT k.symbol, k.stock_name, k.close,
       tw.this_week_vol, lw.last_week_vol,
       (tw.this_week_vol / NULLIF(lw.last_week_vol, 0) - 1) * 100 as volume_change_pct
FROM kr_intraday k
JOIN this_week tw ON k.symbol = tw.symbol
JOIN last_week lw ON k.symbol = lw.symbol
WHERE lw.last_week_vol > 0
ORDER BY volume_change_pct DESC
LIMIT 20

## Conditions
- 과매수 -> rsi > 70
- 과매도 -> rsi < 30
- 골든크로스 -> macd > macd_signal
- 데드크로스 -> macd < macd_signal
- 대형주 -> market_cap >= 10000000000000 (10 trillion KRW)
- 중형주 -> market_cap >= 1000000000000 AND market_cap < 10000000000000
- 상한가 -> change_rate >= 29.9
- 하한가 -> change_rate <= -29.9

- 순매도 -> net_volume < 0

## Question
한국과 미국의 CPI 상승률이 각각 3% 이상인 고인플레이션 시기에 한미 증시의 업종별 방어력을 분석하고, 양국 기준금리와의 연관성을 파악해주세요.

WITH high_inflation_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.date) as month,
    u.value as us_cpi,
    k.data_value as kr_cpi
  FROM us_cpi u
  INNER JOIN bok_economic_indicators k ON DATE_TRUNC('month', u.date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', k.time_value)
  WHERE u.value >= 3.0 
    AND k.data_value >= 3.0
    AND k.stat_name LIKE '%소비자물가지수%'
    AND k.cycle = 'M'
), rate_data AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', f.date) as month,
    AVG(f.value) as us_fed_rate,
    AVG(b.data_value) as kr_base_rate
  FROM us_fed_funds_rate f
  INNER JOIN bok_economic_indicators b ON DATE_TRUNC('month', f.date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', b.time_value)
  WHERE b.stat_name LIKE '%기준금리%'
    AND b.cycle = 'M'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', f.date)
), us_sector_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    h.month,
    s.sector,
    AVG(s.return_1m_median) as avg_monthly_return,
    AVG(s.pe_median) as avg_pe,
    AVG(s.revenue_growth_median) as avg_revenue_growth,
    h.us_cpi,
    h.kr_cpi
  FROM high_inflation_periods h
  INNER JOIN us_sector_benchmarks s ON DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date) = h.month
  GROUP BY h.month, s.sector, h.us_cpi, h.kr_cpi
), market_index_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', m.date) as month,
    m.exchange,
    AVG(m.change_rate) as avg_monthly_return,
    STDDEV(m.change_rate) as monthly_volatility,
    COUNT(*) as trading_days
  FROM market_index m
  WHERE m.exchange IN ('KOSPI', 'NASDAQ')
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', m.date), m.exchange
), combined_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    h.month,
    h.us_cpi,
    h.kr_cpi,
    r.us_fed_rate,
    r.kr_base_rate,
    us.sector,
    us.avg_monthly_return as sector_return,
    us.avg_pe,
    us.avg_revenue_growth,
    k.avg_monthly_return as kospi_return,
    n.avg_monthly_return as nasdaq_return
  FROM high_inflation_periods h
  INNER JOIN rate_data r ON h.month = r.month
  LEFT JOIN us_sector_performance us ON h.month = us.month
  LEFT JOIN market_index_performance k ON h.month = k.month AND k.exchange = 'KOSPI'
  LEFT JOIN market_index_performance n ON h.month = n.month AND n.exchange = 'NASDAQ'
)
SELECT 
  sector,
  COUNT(*) as high_inflation_months,
  ROUND(AVG(sector_return), 2) as avg_sector_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(kospi_return), 2) as avg_kospi_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(nasdaq_return), 2) as avg_nasdaq_return_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(us_cpi), 2) as avg_us_cpi,
  ROUND(AVG(kr_cpi), 2) as avg_kr_cpi,
  ROUND(AVG(us_fed_rate), 2) as avg_us_fed_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(kr_base_rate), 2) as avg_kr_base_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_pe), 1) as avg_sector_pe,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(sector_return) DESC) as inflation_defense_rank
FROM combined_analysis
WHERE sector IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sector
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY avg_sector_return_pct DESC

WITH latest_grade_date AS (
  SELECT symbol, MAX(date) as max_date
  FROM us_stock_grade
  GROUP BY symbol

  FROM us_daily
  GROUP BY symbol

balanced_stocks AS (
  SELECT 
    g.symbol,
    g.stock_name,
    g.final_grade,
    g.final_score,
    g.value_score,
    g.quality_score,
    g.momentum_score,
    g.growth_score,
    g.confidence_score,
    g.beta,
    g.volatility_annual,
    g.max_drawdown_1y,
    g.sharpe_ratio,
    g.var_95,
    g.sector_percentile,
    g.industry_percentile,
    CASE 
      WHEN g.value_score >= 70 AND g.quality_score >= 70 
       AND g.momentum_score >= 70 AND g.growth_score >= 70 
      THEN true ELSE false
    END as all_factors_strong,
    (g.value_score + g.quality_score + g.momentum_score + g.growth_score) / 4.0 as avg_factor_score,
    LEAST(g.value_score, g.quality_score, g.momentum_score, g.growth_score) as min_factor_score
  FROM us_stock_grade g
  JOIN latest_grade_date lgd ON g.symbol = lgd.symbol AND g.date = lgd.max_date
  WHERE g.final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
    AND g.value_score >= 70
    AND g.quality_score >= 70
    AND g.momentum_score >= 70
    AND g.growth_score >= 70
    AND g.beta <= 1.5
    AND g.beta IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  bs.symbol,
  bs.stock_name,
  b.sector,
  b.industry,
  ud.close as current_price,
  bs.final_grade,
  bs.final_score,
  bs.value_score,
  bs.quality_score,
  bs.momentum_score,
  bs.growth_score,
  ROUND(bs.avg_factor_score, 1) as avg_factor_score,
  bs.min_factor_score,
  ROUND(bs.beta, 2) as beta,
  ROUND(bs.volatility_annual, 1) as annual_volatility_pct,
  ROUND(bs.max_drawdown_1y, 1) as max_drawdown_1y_pct,
  ROUND(bs.sharpe_ratio, 2) as sharpe_ratio,
  ROUND(bs.sector_percentile, 1) as sector_percentile,
  ROUND(bs.industry_percentile, 1) as industry_percentile,
  b.market_cap,
  ROUND(ud.change_rate, 2) as daily_change_pct
FROM balanced_stocks bs
JOIN us_stock_basic b ON bs.symbol = b.symbol
JOIN latest_price_date lpd ON bs.symbol = lpd.symbol
JOIN us_daily ud ON bs.symbol = ud.symbol AND lpd.max_date = ud.date
WHERE bs.all_factors_strong = true
ORDER BY bs.final_score DESC, bs.min_factor_score DESC, bs.beta ASC

## Question
연준 금리와 미국 10년물 국채수익률 간 역전(Inverted Yield Curve) 현상이 발생한 기간 동안 VIX 수준별로 미국 섹터 밸류에이션의 디스카운트/프리미엄을 분석하고, 경기방어주 vs 경기순환주의 상대적 매력도를 평가하시오.

WITH yield_curve_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fff.date,
        fff.value as fed_funds_rate,
        uty.value as treasury_10y,
        uty.value - fff.value as yield_spread
    FROM us_fed_funds_rate fff
    INNER JOIN us_treasury_yield uty ON fff.date = uty.date
    WHERE uty.name LIKE '%10-Year%'
      AND fff.date >= '2021-01-01'
      AND uty.value < fff.value  -- Inverted yield curve
), vix_levels AS (
    SELECT 
        date,
        value as vix_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN value < 20 THEN '저변동성'
            WHEN value >= 20 AND value < 30 THEN '중변동성'
            ELSE '고변동성'
        END as vix_regime
    FROM us_vix
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01'
), sector_classification AS (
    SELECT 
        sector,
        CASE 
            WHEN sector IN ('Utilities', 'Consumer Staples', 'Healthcare', 'Real Estate') THEN '경기방어주'
            WHEN sector IN ('Technology', 'Consumer Discretionary', 'Industrials', 'Materials', 'Energy') THEN '경기순환주'
            ELSE '기타'
        END as sector_type
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT sector 
        FROM us_sector_benchmarks
        WHERE sector IS NOT NULL
    ) s
), inversion_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        usb.date,
        usb.sector,
        sc.sector_type,
        vl.vix_regime,
        usb.pe_median,
        usb.forward_pe_median,
        usb.ev_ebitda_median,
        usb.roe_median,
        usb.return_3m_median,
        ycd.yield_spread
    FROM us_sector_benchmarks usb
    INNER JOIN yield_curve_data ycd ON usb.date = ycd.date
    INNER JOIN vix_levels vl ON usb.date = vl.date
    INNER JOIN sector_classification sc ON usb.sector = sc.sector
    WHERE usb.pe_median IS NOT NULL 
      AND usb.ev_ebitda_median IS NOT NULL
      AND sc.sector_type != '기타'
), sector_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        sector_type,
        vix_regime,
        COUNT(*) as observations,
        AVG(pe_median) as avg_pe,
        AVG(forward_pe_median) as avg_forward_pe,
        AVG(ev_ebitda_median) as avg_ev_ebitda,
        AVG(roe_median) as avg_roe,
        AVG(return_3m_median) as avg_3m_return,
        STDDEV(return_3m_median) as return_volatility,
        AVG(yield_spread) as avg_yield_spread
    FROM inversion_periods
    GROUP BY sector_type, vix_regime
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
), relative_valuation AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.*,
        sa.avg_pe - AVG(sa.avg_pe) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.vix_regime) as pe_vs_market,
        sa.avg_ev_ebitda - AVG(sa.avg_ev_ebitda) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.vix_regime) as ev_ebitda_vs_market,
        sa.avg_3m_return / NULLIF(sa.return_volatility, 0) as risk_adjusted_return
    FROM sector_analysis sa
)
SELECT 
    sector_type,
    vix_regime,
    observations,
    ROUND(avg_pe, 1) as avg_pe_ratio,
    ROUND(avg_forward_pe, 1) as avg_forward_pe,
    ROUND(avg_ev_ebitda, 1) as avg_ev_ebitda,
    ROUND(pe_vs_market, 1) as pe_premium_discount,
    ROUND(ev_ebitda_vs_market, 1) as ev_ebitda_premium_discount,
    ROUND(avg_roe, 1) as avg_roe_pct,
    ROUND(avg_3m_return, 2) as avg_3m_return_pct,
    ROUND(return_volatility, 2) as return_volatility,
    ROUND(risk_adjusted_return, 3) as risk_adjusted_return,
    ROUND(avg_yield_spread, 2) as avg_inversion_spread,
    CASE 
        WHEN pe_vs_market < -2 AND avg_3m_return > 0 THEN '할인 매력도 높음'
        WHEN pe_vs_market > 2 AND avg_3m_return < -2 THEN '프리미엄 부담'
        WHEN risk_adjusted_return > 0.5 THEN '위험조정수익률 양호'
        ELSE '중립'
    END as investment_attractiveness,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY vix_regime ORDER BY risk_adjusted_return DESC) as sector_rank_by_vix
FROM relative_valuation
ORDER BY vix_regime, risk_adjusted_return DESC

## Question
대차대조표에서 현금성 자산이 총 부채보다 많고(순현금 보유), 손익계산서에서 영업이익률이 20% 이상이며, 현금흐름표에서 자사주 매입을 활발히 하고 있는(분기당 10억 달러 이상) 배당주 중에서 배당수익률과 기술적 지표를 종합 분석해주세요.

WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) as max_date FROM us_daily
),
latest_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    cash_and_cash_equivalents_at_carrying_value + COALESCE(short_term_investments, 0) as total_cash,
    total_liabilities,
    (cash_and_cash_equivalents_at_carrying_value + COALESCE(short_term_investments, 0)) - total_liabilities as net_cash,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending DESC) as rn
  FROM us_balance_sheet
  WHERE cash_and_cash_equivalents_at_carrying_value IS NOT NULL
),
latest_income AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    total_revenue,
    operating_income,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_revenue > 0 THEN (operating_income::NUMERIC / total_revenue) * 100
      ELSE NULL
    END as operating_margin,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending DESC) as rn
  FROM us_income_statement
  WHERE total_revenue > 0 AND operating_income IS NOT NULL
),
latest_cashflow AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    ABS(COALESCE(payments_for_repurchase_of_common_stock, 0)) as stock_repurchase,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY fiscal_date_ending DESC) as rn
  FROM us_cash_flow
),
qualified_stocks AS (
  SELECT 
    d.symbol,
    b.stock_name,
    b.sector,
    d.close,
    b.dividendyield * 100 as dividend_yield_pct,
    b.dividendpershare,
    i.rsi,
    i.macd,
    i.macd_signal,
    bl.net_cash / 1000000000 as net_cash_billions,
    inc.operating_margin,
    cf.stock_repurchase / 1000000000 as repurchase_billions,
    g.final_score,
    g.value_score
  FROM us_daily d
  INNER JOIN latest_date ld ON d.date = ld.max_date
  INNER JOIN us_stock_basic b ON d.symbol = b.symbol
  INNER JOIN us_indicators i ON d.symbol = i.symbol AND d.date = i.date
  INNER JOIN latest_balance bl ON d.symbol = bl.symbol AND bl.rn = 1
  INNER JOIN latest_income inc ON d.symbol = inc.symbol AND inc.rn = 1
  INNER JOIN latest_cashflow cf ON d.symbol = cf.symbol AND cf.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN us_stock_grade g ON d.symbol = g.symbol AND g.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM us_stock_grade) AND d.date = g.date
  WHERE bl.net_cash > 0
    AND inc.operating_margin >= 20
    AND cf.stock_repurchase >= 1000000000
    AND b.dividendyield > 0
    AND b.dividendpershare > 0
)
SELECT 
  symbol,
  stock_name,
  sector,
  close,
  ROUND(dividend_yield_pct, 2) as dividend_yield_pct,
  dividendpershare,
  ROUND(rsi, 2) as rsi,
  CASE WHEN macd > macd_signal THEN 'Golden Cross' ELSE 'Dead Cross' END as macd_signal_status,
  ROUND(net_cash_billions, 2) as net_cash_billions,
  ROUND(operating_margin, 2) as operating_margin_pct,
  ROUND(repurchase_billions, 2) as repurchase_billions,
  final_score,
  value_score
FROM qualified_stocks
ORDER BY dividend_yield_pct DESC, final_score DESC NULLS LAST

## Term Mapping
## Price/Quote Terms
- 현재가, 종가 -> close
- 시가 -> open
- 고가 -> high
- 저가 -> low
- 거래량 -> volume
- 거래대금 -> trading_value
- 시총, 시가총액 -> market_cap
- 등락률, 변동률 -> change_rate

## Technical Indicators (in kr_indicators or us_indicators)
- RSI, 알에스아이 -> rsi
- MACD -> macd, macd_signal, macd_hist
- 볼린저밴드 -> real_upper_band, real_middle_band, real_lower_band
- 이평선, 이동평균, SMA -> sma
- EMA, 지수이동평균 -> ema
- VWAP -> vwap, eod_vwap, avg_vwap
- ATR -> atr
- 스토캐스틱 -> slowk, slowd
- MFI -> mfi
- ADX -> adx
- ROC -> roc
- OBV -> obv
- CCI -> cci

## Conditions
- 과매수 -> rsi > 70
- 과매도 -> rsi < 30
- 골든크로스 -> macd > macd_signal
- 데드크로스 -> macd < macd_signal
- 대형주 -> market_cap >= 10000000000000 (10 trillion KRW)
- 중형주 -> market_cap >= 1000000000000 AND market_cap < 10000000000000
- 상한가 -> change_rate >= 29.9
- 하한가 -> change_rate <= -29.9

## Investor Types (Korean market only, from kr_individual_investor_daily_trading)
- 외국인, 외인 -> foreign_net_volume, foreign_net_value
- 기관 -> inst_net_volume, inst_net_value
- 개인, 개미 -> retail_net_volume, retail_net_value
- 순매수 -> net_volume > 0
- 순매도 -> net_volume < 0

## Quant Grades (from kr_stock_grade / us_stock_grade)
- 종합등급, 투자등급 -> final_grade
- 종합점수, 최종점수 -> final_score
- 가치점수 -> value_score
- 퀄리티점수, 품질점수 -> quality_score
- 모멘텀점수 -> momentum_score
- 성장점수 -> growth_score
- 신뢰도점수 -> confidence_score
- 매수 등급 -> final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
- 강력 매수 -> final_grade = '강력 매수'
- 매수 고려 이상 -> final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수', '매수 고려')
- 매도 등급 -> final_grade IN ('매도', '강력 매도')

## Market Index
- 코스피 -> exchange = 'KOSPI'
- 코스닥 -> exchange = 'KOSDAQ'
- 나스닥 -> exchange = 'NASDAQ'
- 뉴욕증시 -> exchange = 'NYSE'

## Question
퀀트 매수 추천 종목들의 기술적 지표와 외국인·기관 순매수량 현황을 보여주세요

SELECT
    k.symbol, k.stock_name, k.close,
    g.final_grade, g.final_score,
    i.rsi, i.macd, i.macd_signal,
    t.foreign_net_volume, t.inst_net_volume
FROM kr_intraday k
JOIN kr_stock_grade g ON k.symbol = g.symbol AND g.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_stock_grade)
JOIN kr_indicators i ON k.symbol = i.symbol AND i.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_indicators)
JOIN kr_individual_investor_daily_trading t ON k.symbol = t.symbol AND t.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM kr_individual_investor_daily_trading)
WHERE g.final_grade IN ('강력 매수', '매수')
ORDER BY g.final_score DESC
